request.purpose: Health services research to improve the quality of care for patients with chronic conditions.
request.question: What is the mean BMI of men with COPD, by region?
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of men with COPD who have a BMI and their mean BMI, one decimal.
